chunks: So call on no other god but God, lest you are condemned to torment;
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of calling upon other gods besides Allah?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse reinforces the core message of monotheism (Tawhid) by linking exclusive worship to the avoidance of divine chastisement, a theme resonant with Shia emphasis on purifying faith from shirk. It serves as a concise warning that polytheism not only distorts belief but incurs specific punishment, urging believers to maintain spiritual purity in their devotional acts.
